build_model_from_config: build a PyTorch model from a config dict specifying architecture name and constructor arguments
distribute_model_to_cuda: distribute a PyTorch model to CUDA GPUs using DataParallel or DistributedDataParallel wrapping
build_dataloader_for_dataset: build a PyTorch DataLoader with video and audio transforms for AudioSet or Kinetics datasets
build_optimizer_with_scheduler: build an SGD or Adam optimizer with a MultiStepLR learning rate scheduler from config
restore_checkpoint_with_manager: restore model and optimizer state dicts from a saved checkpoint file using CheckpointManager
